title: ONE SCREEN
rule: the whole portfolio fits on one screen at 1440 x 900, and every project line lights a real screen beside it
description: One screen, no sections. Left: 'Gentrit Rashiti', 'Builds web and mobile apps. Part of two platform rewrites. 5+ years, working remotely from Kosovo.', then Client work (Care platform, Bayyinah TV, Design System v2, Viva Fresh, Read to Feed, Dukagjini Bookstore, Incentiv) and Own projects (Offday, OFFBEAT, FORM), one line each, and Email, GitHub, LinkedIn, CV. Right: the real screen of the current line at 3:2 (care calendar week first), a two-line caption, a switch for the second screen (care: Calendar / Claims; Bayyinah: Library / Series; Design System: Picker / In use), then 'How Gentrit works': the AI line in Instrument Serif italic and a four-step diagram (Rules, AI agents build, Checks, A person approves, and the way back from Checks: 'A check fails? Back to the agents.'), with links to the care and design-system cases. On a phone the list is the page; a panel under 20 % of the height shows the screen of the row at the reading line, and one tap on a row opens it.
signature: Instrument Sans 400/500 at 17 px for almost every word, 14 px for captions and the diagram, one Instrument Serif italic line at 22 px. Paper #F4F1EA, ink #191816, muted #6B675F (dark: #141311 / #ECE8DF / #969186). Motion: pointer rest 80 ms on a line, then the rule under the name slides and resizes (180 ms, transform) and the screen cross-fades (200 ms, opacity, after decode); keyboard moves are instant. Arrival: the first screen fades in once (300 ms); fourteen of the sixteen request marks fall away right to left (380 ms each, 18 ms stagger); the diagram draws once in reading order (stroke-dashoffset, about 0.9 s). Case links fade the page out in 160 ms. Reduced motion: still and complete.
hookSentence: The whole portfolio was one screen, and every line I pointed at showed me the real product.
craftGate: pass: no horizontal scroll and CLS 0 (load and after a full scroll) at 375/390/540/1024/1280/1440; whole page fits 1440x900, 1280x800 and 1024x768; every link and button >= 44 px (CV 44 x 44); focus ring for keyboard only; hover and focus change the screen only with a fine pointer; phone panel 163 px = 19 % of 844, one height; one tap opens a row; 200 % zoom (720 x 450) puts the screen under the name and every row opens with one click; 0 frames over 20 ms in the phone scroll with screen switches at 4x CPU, one 50 ms frame in five hover switches
holdback: Lowest: original, 5/10. A name list that lights a screen beside it is a known studio-index pattern; the page is calm and correct but nobody will tell a friend about it. Smaller: on a phone the panel screens are small (190 x 143 px), so their text is about 8 px; on a touch tablet in two columns the screen changes only with the Calendar / Claims switch, because a tap opens the row.
